value.rationale: The source makes the synchronization point depend on the form factor. Determining its complete attainable set is a natural structural question: the result proves there is no hidden rigidity, because every value in the entire admissible interval can be engineered while preserving positivity, analyticity, coordinate symmetry, and simultaneous behavior at all eight upper extrema. This is a classification/design theorem rather than a numerical specialization.
